answer: Let attestations travel as whispers: each peer sends its verdict privately into a sealed collector, and the claimant never learns who vouched or how strongly until the epoch's dawn opens the log. A colluding cluster can no longer coordinate on which clone to boost, nor punish dissenters mid-round, so buying a quorum becomes a blind wager. When the log opens it is frozen into crystal: a published hash chain over every whisper, letting anyone recompute the tally and prove nothing was inserted or edited afterwards.
